boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Merrimack College
boards.description: Ten food-focused, under-21-safe destinations with currently published late hours in North Andover or nearby Lawrence.

cards.title: Taco Bell
cards.subtitle: 79 Winthrop Avenue, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the official location page to confirm access before heading out; its listed drive-thru and dine-in hours run 24 hours daily.
cards.short_summary: A Lawrence location with round-the-clock listed service.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell lists its 79 Winthrop Avenue, Lawrence location with 24-hour drive-thru and dine-in hours every day.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists drive-thru and dine-in hours as 12:00 AM–12:00 AM daily.

cards.title: McDonald's
cards.subtitle: 599 Andover Street, Lawrence
cards.notes: Plan on the drive-thru for the latest window: the official listing shows 24-hour drive-thru access, while the lobby closes at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-thru option on Andover Street.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald's lists the 599 Andover Street, Lawrence drive-thru as open 24 hours daily and lobby hours through 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: Official page lists the drive-thru as 24 hours daily; restaurant/lobby hours are 6 a.m.–11 p.m.

cards.title: Nagua Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 658 Haverhill Street, Lawrence
cards.notes: Check the day before leaving, then order from the listed Lawrence restaurant; published hours extend to midnight or 1 a.m. depending on day.
cards.short_summary: A Lawrence restaurant with midnight-to-1 a.m. published closings.
cards.evidence_claim: Nagua Restaurant lists hours until midnight Monday, Wednesday and Thursday, and until 1 a.m. Friday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 9 a.m.–midnight on Mon/Wed/Thu and 9 a.m.–1 a.m. Fri–Sun; no Tuesday hours are shown.

cards.title: La Nueva Fogata Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 326 Lowell Street, Lawrence
cards.notes: Use the restaurant’s online ordering or phone contact after checking the current day; its published business hours run through midnight every day.
cards.short_summary: A Lawrence Dominican restaurant listing midnight daily hours.
cards.evidence_claim: La Nueva Fogata Restaurant lists business hours of 7 a.m. to 12 a.m. every day at 326 Lowell Street in Lawrence.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 7 a.m.–12 a.m. Sunday through Saturday.

cards.title: Chipotle Mexican Grill
cards.subtitle: 93 Turnpike Street, North Andover
cards.notes: Place a pickup or delivery order during the listed window, and check the location page on holidays or during campus breaks before departing.
cards.short_summary: A North Andover counter-service option listed until 11 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: Chipotle lists its 93 Turnpike Street, North Andover restaurant hours as 10 a.m. to 11 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official location page lists restaurant hours of 10 a.m.–11 p.m. daily, with pickup and delivery available.

cards.title: G & Z Pizza & Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 55 Berkeley Street, Lawrence
cards.notes: Call or use the restaurant’s order link before making the trip; Friday through Sunday carry its latest listed 11 p.m. closing time.
cards.short_summary: Pizza and restaurant service listed through 11 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: G & Z Pizza & Restaurant lists hours until 11 p.m. Friday, Saturday and Sunday at 55 Berkeley Street in Lawrence.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10 a.m.–11 p.m. Fri/Sat and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Sun; Mon–Thu hours end at 10 p.m.

cards.title: El Caldero Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 34 South Broadway, Lawrence
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s current posted hours, then use its ordering link or visit the South Broadway location during its listed 11 p.m. window.
cards.short_summary: A Lawrence restaurant listing 11 p.m. closes most days.
cards.evidence_claim: El Caldero Restaurant lists hours until 11 p.m. Monday through Saturday and until 10 p.m. Sunday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 10:30 a.m.–11 p.m. Mon–Sat and 10:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Sun.

cards.title: Casa Blanca Mexican Restaurant
cards.subtitle: 1070 Osgood Street, North Andover
cards.notes: Reserve or order pickup using the official site, especially on Friday or Saturday when this North Andover location publishes an 11 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: A North Andover Mexican restaurant with 11 p.m. weekend hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Blanca lists its North Andover location at 1070 Osgood Street and publishes 11 a.m. to 11 p.m. hours Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Fri/Sat hours of 11 a.m.–11 p.m.; Sunday through Thursday close at 10 p.m.

cards.title: Jade North Andover
cards.subtitle: 24 High Street, North Andover
cards.notes: Use the official pickup or delivery page and confirm the day’s service before leaving; Friday and Saturday have the latest listed 10:30 p.m. close.
cards.short_summary: Asian cuisine with pickup and delivery listed until 10:30 p.m. weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Jade North Andover lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:30 a.m. to 10:30 p.m. at 24 High Street.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists Fri/Sat hours until 10:30 p.m.; Sunday through Thursday close at 9:30 p.m.

cards.title: Orzo Trattoria
cards.subtitle: 1085 Osgood Street, North Andover
cards.notes: Check the restaurant’s official hours and order page before heading over; Friday and Saturday service is published through 10 p.m.
cards.short_summary: An Osgood Street trattoria with 10 p.m. Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Orzo Trattoria lists Friday and Saturday hours of 11:30 a.m. to 10 p.m. at 1085 Osgood Street in North Andover.
cards.access_notes: Official site lists 11:30 a.m.–10 p.m. Fri/Sat; Monday–Thursday and Sunday service ends at 9 p.m.
